requirement_text: The DH web system shall provide for authentication and information encryption through a recognized reliable and effective security technology, such as TLS.
The general user shall be able to use the DH system capabilities to monitor and control the environment in his/her home.
The home system shall require an ISP. The ISP should be widely available (cable modem, high speed DSL),
The system shall incude thermostats to monitor and regulate the temperature of an enclosed space.
The system shall include security sound and light alarms, which can be activated when DH senses a security breach from a magnetic contact.
The controller part of thermostat shall provide a 'set point' temperature  to control the flow of heat energy and achieve the set point temperature.
The DH System shall provide users with online FAQ documentation about the DH system installed in their home.
The gateway device shall operate up to a 1000-foot range for indoor transmission.
The DH gateway device shall provide communication with all the DH devices and shall connect with a broadband internet connection.
The system shall adhere to the standards, policies and procedures of the ASHRAE
The system shall be compatible with a centralized HVAC
The humidistat shall provide a reading of the current humidity in the space where the humidistat is located.
The DH System shall allow a web-ready computer, cell phone or PDA to control a home's temperature, humidity, lights, security, and the state of small appliances.
The gateway shall contain an RF Module, which shall send and receive wireless communications between the gateway and the other DH devices
